title: Presentation Content Centering
description: All presentation content must be centered horizontally and vertically. Projektetage intro currently starts at the top because text dispositions incorrectly use the positioned canvas layout.
summary:
Re-fixed slide 2 (Ziel) content pushed to bottom after `position: relative` was reintroduced on `.presentation-arrangement--interactive` (alongside `overflow: visible`).

Removed `position: relative` again so reveal.js `position: absolute` stack overlay is preserved. Kept `overflow: visible` for interaction chrome. Strengthened regression test to assert overflow remains but position:relative does not. Verified live on :6050 Ziel slide — content centered (section position:absolute, headings ~279–762 in 1166px viewport). All 40 renderer tests pass.
